decisions.structure: CSharp BuildReadonlySliceArgument and CreateRuntimeIntSlice consume the canonical RuntimeValue array view; Int view construction now shares TryGetRuntimeArrayView, including inline fixed Int storage.
decisions.branches: Retain static Int GEP, element-type rejection, primary/additional ABI, dynamic/fixed/nominal/local array owners. SLG type dispatch already distinguishes fixed storage from growable header.
decisions.logic: SLG writeValue resolves primary parameter read aliases to %arg when the scheduler intentionally omits a redundant SSA read. Slice projection incorrectly bypasses that authority and spells %v<read>. Use writeValue at each projection operand; preserve aggregate producer selection and evaluation count.
decisions.diagnostics: Original487 and two unchanged primary-parameter focused probes reproduce undefined LLVM; CSharp fixed probe initially reproduced missing canonical runtime shape. Current CSharp5 passes with zero warnings. The local S003 probe was corrected to actual dynamic growth before final qualification; it is a control, not same-input causal evidence.
